caveats: Shares and lift use only artists present in both datasets. Unmatched artists are excluded, not treated as zero.
ListenBrainz is a self-selected community, not all music listeners or Spotify. Personal and community events use the same returned monthly window, interpreted as UTC (export timezone unspecified).
Top-1000 chart truncation and normalized exact-name matching affect coverage; duplicate name rows are summed and homonyms may remain.
Personal plays count known artist/title events of at least 30 seconds; ListenBrainz community counting rules can differ.

releases.sampleRule: Every eighth distinct recording in global monthly top-1000 chart order; chosen without consulting personal history.
caveats: Pilot uses an independent chart sample, not the full personal catalog. Coverage is selective and not representative.
MusicBrainz first-release-date is the earliest cataloged release of this recording, not necessarily the original composition or first performance.

Exact artist/title matching cannot verify Spotify recording versions. Decades describe matched events only. Coverage denominators count normalized artist/title pairs, which can merge whitespace/case variants.

rows.track: The Less I Know The Better

caveats: Normalized exact artist/title is only a recording candidate; Spotify recording versions are unverified. Coverage denominators count normalized artist/title pairs, which can merge whitespace/case variants.
AcousticBrainz stopped accepting submissions in 2022; many newer recordings have no analysis.
Only matched recordings with finite tempo, spectral centroid and average loudness are included. These descriptors are not emotional-state measurements.
PCA uses standardized descriptors and requires at least five matched tracks. Axes are relative to this small sample, not universal sonic traits.
